coverageAssessment.claimedScope: The official Dhi Qar Governorate reports a committee involving the Nasiriyah Municipality director and real-estate registration leadership in city development matters; the governorate also reports urban survey/registration work in Nasiriyah. This establishes local registry involvement, not open parcel coverage.
